name: Cartel Cache
description: Under the old city the cartel keeps the syndicate's weapons in a maze of mine tunnels. Start in the drainage outfall at the bottom and climb three levels to the plaza. On each level the soldier shoots through the guarded tunnel past the cartel's gunmen, while the hacker takes the quiet drain beside it and trades USB keys, laser switches and the goggles for locked doors. The password in the vault gets you through without a war, if you can manage it.
